The '''C7-A7 Guard Droid''' was a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] model that saw use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was bipedal with a roughly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] shape and was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].
